source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 21ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιοι Γάιος, Δάσιος και Ζωτικός»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2562/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 21 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and tells one story for the three. Nicomedia is named as the place and no year at all is given, so this folder carries no `dates` object and no coordinate. The corpus's `zoticus-of-nicomedia` is a different man: his Greek row is already venerated on 22 Αυγούστου in the company of Agathonicus, and two entries on one calendar are two commemorations. The same holds for `dasius-of-axiopolis` and `dasius-companion-of-maron`, and for the seven folders that keep a Gaius on other days. No hymn is printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 21 октября ст. ст. prints «Мчч. Дасия , Гаия и Зотика (303)», and its notice for the three gives the year and the reign: «приняли мученическую кончину в 303 году, при императоре Диоклитиане (284-305)». The folder held no date.
